Sarbartho Mani’s chess journey began when he was just one year old, with a chessboard gifted by his father. Today, the young talent from Kolkata is India’s 2026 National Under-11 Open Champion and he dreams of becoming a world champion. In this video Sarbartho talks about his tournament performance, chess journey and future goals.
Video: Chessbase India
Edit & Interview: Tushar
